MAKE THE FIRST CONVERSATION COUNT

Send the location
with the job.

A city name helps us place the request, but your ZIP code and access details help us plan it. Include the number of trees or stumps, a wide view of the property, and the route equipment would use to reach the work.

For homeowners

Tell us what you want the space to look like when the work is complete. Include cleanup, chip removal, and any later planting or yard project in the conversation so the estimate reflects your priorities.

For landscapers and tree crews

Sending several stump jobs in different communities? Identify each location separately with its own measurements, photos, and requested timing. We’ll discuss which jobs can be accepted and how scope, scheduling, and billing will work.

BEFORE A DATE IS CONFIRMED

A clear plan
for the visit.

  • Property city or community and ZIP code
  • Tree or stump photos and approximate dimensions
  • Gate opening and equipment access
  • Cleanup and haul-away preference
  • Requested timing and any access coordination

SERVICE AREA QUESTIONS

Before we
head your way.

Does a listed community guarantee service?+

No. The directory helps you identify the area for your request. We confirm coverage, job acceptance, pricing, and scheduling after reviewing your address and project details.

Can I request stump grinding after another crew removes the tree?+

Yes. Send the remaining stump’s measurements and photos, the gate or equipment route, and your location. Tell us what cleanup you want and how you plan to use the area afterward.

Is there a fixed price for every city?+

No. Estimates reflect the particular tree or stump, access, equipment needs, cleanup, and location. Ask for the total agreed scope and price before scheduling.
